conditionDescription: Store price sticker on front cover, light soiling near the title, wear on the spine corners, and wavy page edges. See photos.
descriptionText:
Spider-Man: New York Stories trade paperback (Marvel, April 2011), ISBN 978-0-7851-5637-6. Collects the back-up stories from Amazing Spider-Man #634-645 and Annual #37, and Web of Spider-Man #1, #3-5 and #7-11: Spider-Man's untold first meeting with Captain America, Stan Lee and Marcos Martin's "Stan the Man" feature, Frog-Man, Hammerhead, Ben Reilly, Mary Jane, Jackpot and more. Kurt Busiek, Stan Lee, Karl Kesel and others. $19.99 cover price.

Condition: store price sticker (Geoffrey's Comics) on the front cover, light soiling near the title, wear on the spine corners, and wavy page edges (see photos). Binding intact.

Ships in a protective mailer.
